queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: One or more search queries. Each is billed as one query executed. Up to 1,000 per run.

num.title: Results per query
num.description: Organic results to request per query, 1-100.

language.title: Language
language.description: 2+ letter language code (Google hl param), e.g. "en", "es".

device.title: Device
device.description: Forwarded to Serper as-is if set. Not confirmed to change results — Serper's public documentation does not document a stable device-targeting parameter as of this writing.
